title: Cross-Record Validation Spec
description: Checks spanning multiple Knowledge Records. Specification only.

checks.name: Canonical name uniqueness
checks.procedure: Group by normalized canonical_name / canonical_key; fail if two record_ids claim the same key.

checks.name: Alias collision
checks.procedure: Fail if the same alias normalizes to two different record_ids.

checks.name: Cross-reference resolution
checks.procedure: Every target_record_id / SRC-* must exist or be status=planned with notes.

checks.name: Pack membership consistency
checks.procedure: record.pack_id membership must match pack.record_ids and canon_manifest.packs[].record_ids.

checks.name: Foundation direction sanity
checks.procedure: FOUNDATIONAL_FOR should point from foundation toward dependent, consistent with Pack design inventory.

checks.name: Duplicate definition scan
checks.procedure: Compare Canonical Definition hashes/normalized text across KR-*; flag near-duplicates with distinct IDs.

checks.name: Contradiction scan
checks.procedure: High-confidence opposing statements without conflict edge/notes fail.
